description: This is a test class for AddOnStoreSearchController, containing unit tests that verify the behavior of searching, dismissing dialogs, and starting market activities within the context of the app. It uses Robolectric, Mockito, and JUnit for testing Android components.

classes.name: AddOnStoreSearchControllerTest
classes.description: A test class containing unit tests for AddOnStoreSearchController, verifying dialog interactions and intent launching behavior.

methods.name: testSearchHappyPath
methods.description: Tests the flow of searching for add-ons, confirming the dialog, and launching the market intent.

methods.name: testCancelHappyPath
methods.description: Tests the user canceling the search dialog and ensuring no intent is launched.

methods.name: testDismiss
methods.description: Tests dismissing the dialog and ensuring it is properly dismissed.

methods.name: testUtilityStart
methods.description: Tests the utility method for starting the market activity, handling exceptions.

methods.name: testUtilityNoMarketError
methods.description: Tests the utility method for starting the market activity when no exception occurs, verifying the intent data.
